Group A Streptococcus Bacteremia in Persons Who Inject Drugs
Of the 64 cases identified during 2022–2023, a total of 45 (70%) occurred among 38 patients known to be persons who inject drugs
The remainder of the report focuses on these 38 persons with 45 cases of GAS bacteremia.
